By now, it's clear that I really enjoy making shiny apps. I find them simple but really fun and useful! For this one, I wanted to try making an app that saved entries as I wrote in them. I couldn't figure out how to generate my CV so wanted to try making a simplified version of it. As such, I attempted a shiny app where you can save entries. This would, hypothetically, function as a digital journal or notebook. I had to google how to save the data (https://daattali.com/shiny/persistent-data-storage/) and I'm not confident that it works as intended and it's not super pretty but it was worth a shot. 

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(bslib)

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bs_theme(bootswatch = "spacelab"),
  titlePanel("Notebook"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      textInput("text", "Enter text", value = ""),
      actionButton("submit", "Save Entry"), 
      hr(),
      h5("Current Input:"),
      textOutput("display_text") 
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      h3("Saved Journal History"),
      verbatimTextOutput("file_content") 
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  output$display_text <- renderText({
    input$text
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$submit, {
    if(input$text != "") {
      write(paste(Sys.time(), "-", input$text), 
            file = "notebook.txt", 
            append = TRUE)
      
      updateTextInput(session, "text", value = "")
    }
  })
  
  output$file_content <- renderText({
    input$submit 
    
    if (file.exists("notebook.txt")) {
      paste(readLines("notebook.txt"), collapse = "\n")
    } else {
      "No entries yet."
    }
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)


```
